title: Generic counit-normalized derived tensor-route calculation
statement: Use [new-integral-residue-tensor-presentation], [new-integral-residue-derived-monoidal], [new-integral-residue-tensor-model], [new-integral-residue-ordinary-monoidal]. For braided Grothendieck abelian monoidal closed categories C and D with functorial flat resolutions, an additive exact strong monoidal left adjoint F:C→D preserving flat objects, an object B of C, a functor H:D(C)→D(C) exhibited as the left-derived tensorLeft B by a specified counit ε, and ordinary braiding compatibility of F, the composite LF(derivedTensorPresentationIso B H ε) followed by the canonical derived tensor comparison and tensorModelTarget F B P equals tensorModelMap F B H ε P for every homotopy complex P. No flatness of B or P is required. The concrete internal-module pullback satisfies the required ordinary braiding compatibility.

proof.text: Check ordinary mapModComap braiding after precomposing with the balanced tensor epimorphism, then transport it along the canonical scalar-extension/pullback comparison.

Check compatibility of the homotopy comparison with braiding directly: on every complex tensor summand the two Koszul signs coincide and ordinary braiding compatibility applies; then pass to the homotopy quotient. Compare derived braiding on K-flat-image representatives using Qh braiding and the counit equation, and transport along resolutions by naturality and cancellation. Move inverse braiding and the coefficient comparison through the derived tensor comparison, then use presentation normalization and counit naturality to obtain tensorModelMap.

proof_origin.note: A2 second reading: remove the concrete restatement hole and prove the generic calculation and ordinary braiding. Compute the Koszul and isomorphism-transport identities directly inside the proof, avoiding the broad upstream braiding import and its unrelated open localization theorem. No upstream declaration is changed.

lean.statement: theorem residue_tensor_route_model_generic (m : F.leftDerivedFunctor.Monoidal) (hm : ∀ K M : DerivedCategory C, letI := m Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ F.leftDerivedFunctor K M = (F.leftDerivedTensorComparison.app K).app M) (B : C) (H : DerivedCategory C ⥤ DerivedCategory C) (ε : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ H ⟶ (tensorLeft B).mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh) [H.IsLeftDerivedFunctor ε (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso C (.up ℤ))] (t : H ≅ tensorRight ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor C 0).obj B)) (ht : t = derivedTensorPresentationIso B H ε) (hF : ∀ X Y, F.map (β_ X Y).hom ≫ Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ F Y X = Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ F X Y ≫ (β_ (F.obj X) (F.obj Y)).hom) (P : HomotopyCategory C (.up ℤ)) (a : F.leftDerivedFunctor.obj (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj P) ⊗ F.leftDerivedFunctor.obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor C 0).obj B) ⟶ DerivedCategory.Qh.obj ((F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj (Functor.tensorModelCoefficient B) ⊗ (F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj P)) (ha : a = F.tensorModelTarget B P) (b : F.leftDerivedFunctor.obj (H.obj (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj P)) ⟶ DerivedCategory.Qh.obj ((F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj (Functor.tensorModelCoefficient B) ⊗ (F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj P)) (hb : b = F.tensorModelMap B H ε P) : letI := m F.leftDerivedFunctor.map (t.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj P)) ≫ Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ F.leftDerivedFunctor (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj P) ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor C 0).obj B) ≫ a = b
